units.source_text: 她想：“可怜我身死之后，世事终不能隐瞒到底，她们自会探悉我的真名实姓。

en.t: She thought, "Poor me, after I die, the truth will not be hidden forever; they will surely discover my real name and identity.

units.source_text: 那时她们将恨我冷淡，怨我隐瞒吧。”

en.t: Then they will hate me for being cold and resent me for keeping it concealed."

units.source_text: 她左思右想了一会，从容说道：“过去之事我全都忘记了。

en.t: After thinking it over from every side for a while, she said calmly, "I have forgotten everything from the past.

units.source_text: 惟有看到你们缝制这种女装时，才隐约地想起往事，不胜感伤。”

en.t: Only when I see you sewing such women's garments do I dimly recall former days, and I cannot help feeling deeply moved."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“你虽说忘记，记得起的事一定甚多。

en.t: The younger nun said, "Although you say you have forgotten, there must be many things you can still remember.

units.source_text: 永远对我隐瞒，叫我好生怨恨！

en.t: Keeping them hidden from me forever makes me feel terribly resentful!

units.source_text: 这种世俗服装的配色，我久已忘记，针线手段又很拙劣，看见了只是使我想起已故的女儿。

en.t: I long ago forgot how to match colors for worldly clothes like these, and my needlework is very clumsy; seeing them only makes me think of my late daughter.

units.source_text: 你也有如此关怀你的母亲在世间么？

en.t: Do you too have a mother in this world who cares about you so much?

units.source_text: 像我，虽然明知女儿已经亡故，还是疑心她住在某地方，希望至少要找到这个地方才好。

en.t: As for me, though I know perfectly well that my daughter has died, I still imagine she may be living somewhere, and I wish I could at least find that place.

units.source_text: 何况你去向不明，定然有许多人在思念你吧。”

en.t: All the more since no one knows where you have gone, surely many people must be thinking of you."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我在俗世之时，原有一个母亲。

en.t: Ukifune answered, "When I was still in the secular world, I did have a mother.

units.source_text: 但现在恐怕已经亡故了吧。”

en.t: But by now she has probably passed away."
After saying this, she began to shed tears.

units.source_text: 为欲排遣哀情，又说：“回忆往事，反会引起悲伤，所以我不对你说。

en.t: Wanting to dispel her sorrow, she added, "Remembering the past only brings on more sadness, so I do not speak of it to you.
It is certainly not because I wish to hide anything from you."
She was always a woman of few words.
